title: Loopress project configuration
description: Project-level config for the Loopress CLI (loopress.json).

rootDir.description: Base directory for all Loopress paths. All other path options are resolved relative to this directory.

snippetsDir.description: Directory where code snippets are read from and written to, relative to rootDir.

acfDir.description: Directory where ACF field groups, post types, taxonomies and options pages are read from and written to, relative to rootDir.

seoDir.description: Directory where SEO settings, post meta, and redirects (RankMath and Yoast SEO, whichever is active) are read from and written to, relative to rootDir.

formDir.description: Directory where forms (WPForms today) are read from and written to, relative to rootDir.

pageDir.description: Directory where WordPress pages are read from and written to, relative to rootDir.

apiDir.description: Directory where custom API route files are read from and written to, relative to rootDir.

appsDir.description: Directory where single-page app bundles are read from and written to, relative to rootDir. Each subdirectory is one app: a loopress.app.json plus a built dist/ folder.

projectId.description: Project identifier from the global Loopress config. When set, takes precedence over the currently active project in the global config.

plugins.description: WordPress.org plugins managed by Loopress, installed via Composer + WPackagist on the site. Keys are plugin slugs. A value is either an exact version to pin (e.g. "9.4.2") or "latest" to track the newest release on every push. Removing an entry uninstalls the plugin on the next push. Ignored when a composer.json exists in rootDir (that file becomes authoritative).

themes.description: WordPress.org themes managed by Loopress, installed via Composer + WPackagist on the site. Keys are theme slugs; values are an exact version or "latest". Loopress manages installed theme versions only, it never switches the active theme. Ignored when a composer.json exists in rootDir.
